title: Acknowledgments and Collaborations in Scientific Research
summary: This cluster highlights the collaborative nature of scientific research, where individuals and tools acknowledge and thank each other for contributions. BJB and Barry Dion express gratitude to MKR and MJD, respectively, while Alex White thanks MJD. Bob Waterston thanks BJB, and Grant Brown also thanks MJD. The cluster also includes a Bio-Rad CHEF gel apparatus gifted to BJB, and DNA repair mutants adapting to a chemostat culture. Many undergraduate student helpers are also acknowledged by BJB.
